_note: TEACHES THE ECONOMY. Won by owning a house AND ten villagers.
TWO WIN ROWS, AND THEY ARE ANDed. 'A house and ten villagers' is one objective in two
halves, which is exactly what multiple `win` rows mean (PLAN.md 11.8). An OR would
need grouping and no scenario wants one yet.
WHY 10 VILLAGERS RATHER THAN A ROUND 5: MapGen starts every player with 5, so a target
of 5 is a scenario already won on tick 0 and would teach nothing. The lesson is that
THE OPPONENT IS PASSIVE, which runs its whole economy and never attacks -- so this
scenario cannot be lost by being raided while you learn. Elimination is still the loss
(you own nothing, you are out), because that is true on every map in this game whatever
a file declares, which is why no lose condition is written here.
SCENARIO MODE MUST NOT LET CONQUEST WIN THIS (15.2): killing the passive AI's five
villagers and its town centre must NOT end this in victory with two villagers and no
house, or the scenario teaches the opposite of its name.
name: How To Gather and Build
description: Villagers gather food, wood, gold and stone, and they build. Put up a house and grow to ten villagers.
message:
Tap a villager, then tap a tree or a berry bush to gather. Tap your town centre to train more villagers. Build a house from the build menu to raise your population cap.

Goal: own 1 house and 10 villagers.
_note_map: A PINNED SEED IS NOT A PINNED MAP (PLAN.md 11.7). `seed` reproduces this map only
